lines.3: 「Huh!? What an old-lady thing to say.」
lines.4: 「So third-years are old hags now? Don't worry. Older women have their own flavor.」
lines.5: 「Shut up and go back to your owner.」
lines.6: 「Whoa! Striking me without warning to silence me? How Machiavellian! I will resist to the bitter end. I'll sue!」
lines.7: 「You pick fights with me over everything. Is there something you actually want to say?」
lines.9: 「Fine. I'm a man too. I'll say it straight.」
lines.10: 「Take off the sunglasses. I told you they're against the rules.」
lines.11: 「O-Otome. I am in love with you. Will you be my woman?」
lines.13: 「I have no inclination to dote on birds.」
lines.14: 「And thus, a love has ended here today!!」
